- **Base case**:  
  $ a(1) = 1 $

- **Recursive case**:  
  For $ n > 1 $,  
  $$
  a(n) = 
  \begin{cases} 
  a(n-1) + 1 & \text{if } n \text{ is prime} \\
  a(n-1) & \text{if } n \text{ is not prime}
  \end{cases}
  $$

### Final Answer:

$$
\boxed{
a(1) = 1, \quad a(n) =
